_comment: What the labels in a gridmarks chunk ARE, from the discipline of the sheet
they are printed on: 'marks' (C-6, SR-8, PC1 on a structural sheet) or
'tags' (A4B, S1B, B2 — unit, room, door or equipment tags on an
architectural or MEP sheet). The rule is implemented twice: gridLabelKind
in @cdip/shared (the chat prompt and the source chip) and
gridmarks.grid_label_kind in the worker (the summary prompt). Both sides
read THIS fixture in their tests, so a change to the rule in one language
fails the other's suite — a chat calling A4B a tag while the summary of
the same sheet calls it a column mark is the drift this prevents.
Unknown (not yet scraped) and 'other' stay 'marks': the reader's own
neutral word, not a claim about the sheet.
